credits.title: The Education of Jane Cumming
credits.overview: Edinburgh, 1810. Two female teachers find themselves at the centre of a scandal when one of their pupils accuses them of having a love affair.

credits.title: SO ALIVE!
credits.overview: A fictional boy aims to become a non-fictional rapper. His label has other plans.

credits.title: Tornado
credits.overview: When her father's puppet samurai show gets ambushed by a notorious gang, Tornado vows to seek vengeance and forge her own destiny by stealing their ill-gotten gold.

When his family can no longer look after him, he is moved to Twilight Towers, an old people's home.
